_id: The book's 古四 to 古六 (story/jiuding-lu/04-第四回.md … 06-第六回.md since the 2026-10-02 rename; once 第一章 · 外门, then 第三回 until 2026-09-30), between the prologue and 冀: an id that sorts after 00-prologue and before 01-ji (chapters run in id order, core.mjs advanceChapter).
_map: 观内 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: 「可以，按你的建议做」 — supersedes the 10-05 free-play area): while he is an 外门 disciple he roams INSIDE 沉鼎观 — 外门, 饭堂, 讲堂, 柴房, 演武场, 正殿, 执事堂, 藏经阁, 药园, 后山崖顶, 山门. Below the mountain (坊市, 渡口, 泗水, 彭城 …) is walled: refused with `say`, greyed on the map. Two things open a way past it, only the places on that way (world.mjs leaveOf): the story's scene standing off the map (石门 for the 秘境 — the road from the 观 to it, while that scene is ahead), and a 执事堂 令 (an errand declaring `pass`: the road to that one place, spent once the errand is done and he is back inside). A save standing off every way is put back at `home` with `back` (world.mjs fitLeave).

say.zh: 外门弟子，无令不得下山。周衡的账本上，每一步都记着。
say.en: Outer disciples may not leave the mountain without leave. Every step goes in Zhou Heng's ledger.

back.zh: 外门弟子，无令不得下山。你回到了外门，周衡的账本上又添了一笔。
back.en: Outer disciples may not leave the mountain without leave. You are back in the outer court, and Zhou Heng's ledger has one more line.

back_story.zh: 事了了。你随着众人，一步一步走回了外门。
back_story.en: It is over. You walk back up to the outer court with the others, step by step.

_beats: 剧情 × 开放世界 (design.md, his 2026-09-28): five key beats lock the map from the scene after their entry to their last (world.mjs beatOf); between them the area is open, with the threads in quests/xu.json. The entry of each is a waypoint the player walks to.

say.zh: 讲堂还没散，夜还没过。先把眼前的事做完。
say.en: The lesson isn't over, nor the night. Finish what is before you first.

say.zh: 你一身是伤，哪儿也去不了。
say.en: You are hurt all over; you are going nowhere.

beats._scenes: 2026-10-26 (全文后的小游戏 第二批): wm-xiongya (the cleft and the climb, 时机 `xiongya`) is the first scene inside, walked down to from `home` past the 凶崖's 犰狳 (world.mjs fitSealed); wm-kouzi and wm-shiting play at the door before it, outside the beat, as the rerun rooms hold no story scene. wm-shishi plays in the chamber before wm-xirang's fight. wm-anhe (the dry river's throw, split from wm-xirang's swallow 2026-10-20) is inside too — left off this list until 2026-10-31, so the seal let go there and came back at wm-tama. wm-tama (the ledge, after the dry river) is inside, in the 崖壁 room. wm-hetan (阿禾 on the mudflat, the riverbed outside the door) is its last scene, told in the 崖壁 room as wm-chu is; its way home lets the seal go.

say.zh: 秘境的石门在身后合上了。三天后才开。
say.en: The stone door has shut behind you. It opens again in three days.

beats._sealed: 秘境 mode (Hanli, 2026-10-15: 「yes」): a beat that declares `sealed` is an instance — from the scene after its entry through its last scene he is inside (world.mjs sealedOf). Its `places` are the only map: Move, roads and 去往 offer them (the plate `mijing`, drawn in ink); a way out is refused with `say`. A room in `opens` stays hidden until that scene is behind him. The scene first stood in inside puts him at `home`; a save standing outside is put at its scene's room. Outside errands, 令, chores, the 货郎, 机缘, festival, 节气 and weather are frozen and kept out of Look (rules/sealed.mjs); a 机缘 still live at the door gets its time back on the way out. `days`: the book's own day or night per scene (header 「沉鼎秘境 · 第一夜」); `goals`: the one thing to do in each (the 事 book's goal line). Nothing here names the 秘境: the 外门大比 or a later 秘境 declares the same.

say.en: The realm is sealed. There is no way out.

wm-wangzuo.en: Open the wall the wind comes through

wm-kunzhen.en: Get away from the drop alive

wm-shishi.en: See to the earth that grows by itself

wm-xirang.en: Keep the pinch of living soil

wm-anhe.en: In the dark, by ear, shoot at the red glow

wm-tama.zh: 背贴着崖根，活过那四条火蛇
wm-tama.en: Back to the cliff, outlive the four fire snakes

wm-kaikai.en: Stay in the soil until it has grown in

wm-chu.en: Wait for the stone door and walk out

wm-hetan.en: Wait for the tide, and walk out

sealed._rerun: 刷副本 retired 2026-10-28 (Hanli: 「按你说的来」 — three cooldown events instead: 兽潮 · 比武切磋 · 妖兽出没; doc/status.md). The story's own 秘境 above is unchanged; the outer rooms no longer open again. A save that stood in a run leaves it on load (state.mjs fitWorld). The 秘境 comes back later as a roguelite map run (design.md § Backlog).

say.zh: 大比正在进行，台下三百双眼睛。
say.en: The contest is on, and three hundred pairs of eyes are watching.
Elder Qu is still waiting for you.

_goal: The chapter's one goal and its countdown on the goal line (errands.mjs goalOf): the story's date until 周衡's notice 「外门大比，明日」 (the mark `dabi-eve`, on wm-luobo's way on since 2026-10-20 — wm-chu's rest before), then 明日. No real-day wait any more (2026-09-30): the eve is a scene in the story (wm-qianye, 大比前夜 — the book's 古八 § 一, and the rumour of 马家's trees), and the contest follows it at once.

date.en: the eighth of the twelfth month

_title: The arc's own name, no number: the player is told the 回 (卷一 · 古四 … 古六, book.json via the scenes' `hui`, rules/hui.mjs).
_close: The ending card on the stage once the chapter is over and the next one waits (story.mjs closeOf): 古八's 「完」 for the 回 it ends on (rules/hui.mjs, never written here), one line of what THIS player did — each `did` part whose `if` holds on the save (cast · owed · not; none: always), joined — and the next chapter's teaser in the book's voice.

did.zh: 你收了药园那只偷萝卜的小狰
did.en: You took in the little Zheng that robbed the herb garden
The garden thief got away from you

did.zh: 大比台下把站不起来的孙二狗拉了起来
did.en: below the contest stage pulled up Sun Ergou when he couldn't stand

did.zh: 以四层把内门的六层扔下了台，一路打进决赛
did.en: at layer four threw an inner-court layer six off the stage and fought all the way to the final

did.zh: 输给了九层的祁长松，那颗筑基丹没拿着，名字进了内门名册
did.en: lost to Qi Changsong of layer nine — no Foundation pill, but your name went into the inner register

did.zh: 又拜了扫了五十年台阶的瞿老为师
did.en: and became the student of Elder Qu, who swept the steps for fifty years

teaser.zh: 却说大比第二天，你卷了铺盖，从外门的大通铺搬进了内门西廊——四张铺，一扇窗，两个九层的老师兄，睡着了也在吐纳；你把胸口那块木牌攥得比从前更紧。
teaser.en: Now the day after the contest you rolled up your bedding and moved from the outer court's long bunk into the inner court's west wing — four beds, a window, two old layer-nine seniors who breathe their exercises even asleep; and you held the wooden token on your chest tighter than ever.

summary.zh: 外门的日子，是从交钱开始的。褚先生说杂灵根是漏勺；那天夜里，你一夜通了小周天——银月替你凿了两道半。柴房里二十三下，换来一只小铜炉；药园的贼不认字，吃了你的萝卜；沉鼎秘境里一撮息壤，撑开了你的五扇门；凶崖上，老蔫没有回来。宗门大比，四层的你把内门的六层扔下了台，拿一面饭桶开出来的破镜子把那面镜子的光照了回去，那面镜子裂了，你那面碎了；决赛叫九层的祁长松退了一步，还是输给了他，筑基丹归了他，你进了内门名册。扫了五十年台阶的瞿老，收你为徒。
summary.en: Outer-sect life starts with paying up. Master Chu says a mixed root is a leaky ladle; that night your qi goes round the small circuit in one go — Yinyue had chiselled two and a half gates for you. Twenty-three blows behind the woodshed buy a little bronze burner; the herb-garden thief can't read, and eats your radish; a pinch of living soil in the Sunken Cauldron secret realm opens your five doors; on the Cliff of Danger, Old Wilt does not come back. At the sect contest, at the fourth layer, you throw an inner-sect sixth layer off the stage and throw the mirror's light back with a broken mirror the Rice Bucket spat out: his mirror cracks, yours shatters; in the final you make Qi Changsong of the ninth layer take a step back, and lose to him all the same; the Foundation pill goes to him, and your name goes into the inner-sect register. Elder Qu, who swept the steps for fifty years, takes you as his disciple.

intro.zh: 外门的日子，是从交钱开始的。
intro.en: Life in the outer court starts with paying up.

_mystery: The riddle hints until the 秘境 is behind him: 息壤 is named only once wm-xirang is passed (story.mjs mysteryOf).

mystery.zh: 泗水底下的秘境，人人手里一张地图。地图上没画的地方，有什么？
mystery.en: Everyone who enters the realm under the Si carries a map. What lies where the map shows nothing?

mystery_after.zh: 三百年没人进过的石室里，为什么放着一撮息壤？
mystery_after.en: Why was there a pinch of living soil in a stone chamber no one had entered in three hundred years?
